release_notes: FOODEX 1.0.71: Promote the post-1.0.70 Dashboard changes merged through PR #1265 into a new immutable FOODEX Dashboard release. Add the three locked Customer 360 legacy-report replicas from Issue #1261 / PR #1262: customer statement, detailed item withdrawals and item withdrawals, with authoritative B2B data, exact Arabic layout conventions, browser preview/print and real PDF download. Fix Dashboard live Van visibility from PR #1265 by accepting authenticated Van GPS heartbeats, inheriting assignment/store scope, and keeping authorized Van runtime presence visible on the fleet map. Synchronize Customer, Driver and Van source identities at 1.0.71+71 for the release contract while keeping Android publication/installed-APK policy unchanged; the Dashboard Update ZIP does not replace installed APKs.
